about: Renders a value as text that turns into a field in place. A press, Enter or Space opens the field, Enter saves the value, Escape restores it, and focus returns to the text or the edit button.

activation.about: `activationMode` sets what opens the field: a press or Enter (`click`, the default), a double press or Enter (`dblclick`), or focus (`focus`), which opens it as Tab reaches the text.
activation.title: Opening the field

heading.about: A document title at size `lg` with no triggers. A press on the title opens the field, and the input's `aria-label` names it. An empty title shows the placeholder.
heading.title: Title without triggers

leave:
Leave the parcel with the concierge.
The code for the gate is 4071.

lines.about: `Editable.Textarea` takes several lines. Enter adds a line, and Control and Enter save the notes. The preview keeps the line breaks.
lines.title: Several lines

required.about: Inside a field the input takes the field's label and the preview names itself after it. Saving an empty name marks the field invalid and shows its error text through `onValueCommit`.
required.title: Required, in a field

shown: Shown on your profile and beside your comments.

size.about: The height of the text and the field reads the control scale, and the triggers read the tag scale at the same size.
size.title: Sizes

states.about: An empty value shows the placeholder. An invalid value draws the error edge. A read-only value is plain text with no triggers to press, and a disabled one is dimmed and leaves the tab order.
states.title: States

title: Editable
